$comment: SINGLE SOURCE for the findings loop (R1-09/F2): .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/catalog-finding.yml is GENERATED from this file (python -m catalog.findings_schema --write-template), apply_findings.py reads FINDING_COLS/STRUCT_COLS/ACTIONS/finding_types from it, ingest_issues.py maps issue-form headings to columns with it, and the CATALOG_AUDITOR profile text lists finding_types from it. tests/test_findings_schema.py asserts template == generated.

coverage_gap.description: a value is recoverable from cited evidence but missing

missing_paper.description: an own-data paper is not linked

triage_error.description: alias of wrong_verdict used by the Auditor profile

universe_miss.description: an in-scope study is absent from the universe

wrong_sample_unit.description: sample_unit (biosample / run / pooled) is wrong — needs a pipeline re-key, recorded as a study note

confirmed_correct.description: a human checked the value and it is right (truth-set row; evidence optional)

study_verdict.writes: study_metadata_wide + universe_studies_all catalog_status/decision_stage; excluded studies leave sample_metadata_wide

add_study.writes: audit/candidates_<date>.csv for the next triage cycle (never a direct include)

confirm.writes: confirmations.parquet + <field_name>__verified = true in sample_metadata_wide (sample-level) or study_metadata_wide.verified_fields (study-level)

routes.H: human / external curation (default for external_curation.* sources)

issue_form.name: Catalog finding
issue_form.title: [finding] <identifier>: <field or verdict>
issue_form.description: Report a wrong, missing or unsupported value, verdict or link in the Infant Gut Shotgun-Metagenome Catalog — or confirm a value is correct
issue_form.date_and_source_from: issue.created_at (date) and issue.number (source) — filled by ingest_issues.py, never typed by hand

release_columns.$comment: R2026.1 (config/releases.yaml, docs/RELEASES.md): appended at the end of every fact table; sample_metadata_wide has none
release_columns.release_added: str — release id (R<YYYY>.<n>) or pre-numbered package semver in which the row first became visible; pre-1.3.0 values reconstructed from value_history.change_stage / src_track
release_columns.release_retired: str|null — release that replaced/removed the row; null = current
release_columns.package_added: str — semver of the package in which the row first appeared
release_columns.release_tag_note: the structured finding column release_tag (data-v<semver>) names the package the finding was raised against; apply_findings rows applied in release R get release_added = R

contribute_worklist.$comment: R2026.2 (config/contribute.yaml is the single source; docs/CONTRIBUTE.md): contribute_worklist.csv (one row per open include/uncertain study) and contribute_worklist_fields.csv (study × 6 fields). Values here MUST equal contribute.yaml (tests/test_contribute_worklist.py + test_findings_schema).
